limitations: Published region centers are study points. Landing safety and trajectory reachability are outside the model.
Solar qualification uses positive apparent Sun-center clearance and Earth occultation of the Sun center. Time below threshold can include partial-disk illumination.
Earth-center geometric line of sight cannot establish a communications link or station availability.
Two-metre observer height, radial up, astronomical bodies evaluated in airless reception geometry.

The model assigns each LOLA cell a constant radial height. In the narrow transition annulus, both scales contribute and the higher apparent terrain wins. Nominal 5 m pixels are largely interpolated. Surface roughness below the DEM scale and DEM reconstruction error are outside the numerical bounds.
Horizon enclosures use spherical caps around each projected cell rather than sampling at a few rays.
The far-field cap assumes no unmodeled point exceeds 1,750 km lunar radius. Sector uncertainty is retained when the cap or the numerical terrain envelope spans the target elevation.
The 0.03°/min angular-motion envelope is specific to this bounded date range and sites. Time-grid and terrain sensitivity limits measure numerical and model variation.
Half-open UTC mission windows. Candidate starts are evaluated on a user-selected UTC grid.
manifest.transformations: Native LOLA cells to lunar Cartesian elevation bounds. Refine terrain ranges, angular bins and apparent directions, retain both interval enclosures, export compressed runs.

comparison_conventions.horizons_correction: Airless apparent; additionally includes relativistic deflection
comparison_conventions.interpretation: Topocentric implementation comparison with shared JPL ephemeris lineage; tests no terrain or physical visibility.
comparison_conventions.lunar_horizons_frame: MEAN_ME (DE440-family realization of DE421 mean Earth/polar axis)

visibilityDefinitions.earth: Apparent Earth center clears the terrain skyline. Surface-terrain line of sight only.
visibilityDefinitions.joint: Both Sun-center qualification and Earth-center line of sight.
visibilityDefinitions.sun: Apparent Sun center clears the terrain skyline and is outside the apparent Earth disc. Center qualification excludes solar-disc fraction, full shadow and solar-array power.
visibilityDefinitions.uncertain: Numerical or terrain bounds overlap the qualification threshold.
visibilityDefinitions.unknown: Unresolved terrain coverage or timestamps beyond the offline bundle.
